text:
maria_pm: Quick sync — post-launch patch planning. AcmeCorp flagged two regressions and a UX polish request. We need to decide: shove both regressions into tomorrow's hotfix (riskier), or land one hotfix + schedule the other as high-priority backlog item for next sprint? Also want to confirm launch criteria still met for follow-on milestone (metrics, SLOs, docs).

alex_se: Can you paste repro + severity for both regressions? Might be 5–10m fix vs deeper rollback.

maria_pm: Repros below (from support thread). Short summary: 1) search results occasionally drop items (high-impact for enterprise customers). 2) streaming chat sometimes truncates end-of-response on long prompts (medium). Support says 1 affects ~3 customers (AcmeCorp primary).

ben_ds: From telemetry, error rate spike on search is correlated with the 2026-03-18 ranking change rollout. We can rollback ranking tweak quickly. If rollback, ask infra about capacity for canary.

jia_design: For the chat truncation, do we have a reproducible prompt set? UX wants a fallback displayed to users if truncation occurs (e.g., "...response truncated, click to continue"). Low effort to show fallback.

sam_sre: Rolling back ranking tweak is low-risk; canary in prod now. If we rollback, need a brief deploy window (5m) and a monitoring runbook — I'll own it.

alex_se: I can do a quick PR to guard the streaming edge-case (flush final token) and include a unit test. Should be <2h. If we do the rollback, we still should land the streaming guard in next patch.

maria_pm: Proposal: rollback ranking tweak immediately (owner: sam_sre), cut hotfix that includes streaming guard + UX fallback for chat (owner: alex_se + jia_design). If hotfix proves flaky, revert and move streaming guard to next sprint while keeping high-priority backlog ticket for search.

ben_ds: +1 for rollback first. We should also add a short eval against AcmeCorp's query set to validate after rollback. I'll run that and report delta.

jia_design: I'll draft the fallback copy and a quick mock for the chat truncation banner. ETA 2 hours.

maria_pm: OK — owners: sam_sre (rollback), alex_se (stream guard + hotfix PR), jia_design (fallback UX), ben_ds (validation), maria_pm (customer comms). Can we aim for hotfix deploy today by EOD?

alex_se: I'll target a PR by 15:00 PT, small canary.

sam_sre: Rolling back ranking tweak now — canary started. deploy-bot: Deploy started by sam_sre on ranking-service v2026.03.18-rollback (canary) at 1778890200.

deploy-bot: Canary success — no increased errors in 10m window. Rolling out to 20% at 1778890400.

ben_ds: Validation run started against AcmeCorp queries. Will post before/after numbers.

alex_se: PR up: https://gitlab.redwood/infra/stream-guard MR 4321 — unit tests passing locally. Requesting review from @jia_design for UX markup.

jia_design: Reviewed, small tweak to copy. Approved.

maria_pm: Thanks all. If rollback + canary continue to look good, we proceed with hotfix window at 17:30 PT. If anything regresses we abort and escalate. I'll prep customer note for AcmeCorp and keep them in the loop.

ben_ds: Pre/post numbers: search recall dropped 7.4% after ranking change, after canary rollback it's back within 0.5% of baseline. Posting details in thread.

sam_sre: Canary at 50% now; no regression spikes. Preparing final rollout at 80%.

alex_se: Hotfix PR merged to release branch. Deploy scheduled at 17:30 PT.

maria_pm: Decision log: rollback ranking tweak (complete), hotfix contains streaming guard + UX fallback, target deploy today EOD. If any instability, revert. Follow-on milestone: add regression test suite for AcmeCorp queries and formalize launch criteria checklist (metrics, SLOs, customer acceptance). Creating backlog ticket now. :white_check_mark:

sam_sre: Deploy complete; hotfix live at 1778890800. No immediate errors.

maria_pm: Closing loop — I'll send update to AcmeCorp and update the roadmap ticket with new priorities. Thanks team :heart:
